# Linked Structure of Trees

#### Course: DSA with C++

## Linked Structure of Trees

Let's see how we store trees in the computer memory.

First we'll allocate memory for two different elements:

- One for each node.
- One for a special container that stores references to its children.

![Allocate Memory for Node and a Container](data:image/png;base64,)

### Node Attributes

Our node will contain three attributes:

1. The data element.
2. Reference to the parent node.
3. Reference to the special container.

So our node (say, node A) will look something like this:

![Node in Linked Structure](data:image/png;base64,)

Both the parent node and the child nodes will have the similar structure. Here's what the children of node A will look like:

![Child Nodes in Linked Structure](data:image/png;base64,)
